BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE course_version DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_course_version_tech_version;
ALTER TABLE tech_version DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS tech_version_tech_id_fkey;
ALTER TABLE course DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_course_main_tech;
ALTER TABLE course_tech DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS course_tech_tech_id_fkey;
ALTER TABLE compose_config_tech DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS compose_config_tech_tech_id_fkey;
ALTER TABLE course_tag DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS course_tag_tag_id_fkey;
ALTER TABLE lesson_tag DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS lesson_tag_tag_id_fkey;
ALTER TABLE course_version_i18n DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS course_version_i18n_i18n_id_fkey;
ALTER TABLE lesson_i18n DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS lesson_i18n_i18n_id_fkey;
ALTER TABLE task_i18n DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS task_i18n_i18n_id_fkey;
ALTER TABLE task_test_i18n DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS task_test_i18n_i18n_id_fkey;
ALTER TABLE task_test_variant_i18n DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS task_test_variant_i18n_i18n_id_fkey;

ALTER TABLE i18n RENAME TO i18n_new_034;
ALTER TABLE i18n_new_034 DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS i18n_pkey;
ALTER TABLE i18n_new_034 DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS i18n_id_key;
ALTER TABLE i18n_new_034 DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS i18n_language_key;

CREATE TABLE i18n (
    language character(2) NOT NULL,
    id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY
);

ALTER TABLE i18n ADD CONSTRAINT i18n_id_key UNIQUE (id);
ALTER TABLE i18n ADD CONSTRAINT i18n_language_key UNIQUE (language);

INSERT INTO i18n (id, language)
SELECT id, language
FROM i18n_new_034
ORDER BY id;

SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('i18n', 'id'), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM i18n), 1), true);

ALTER TABLE tech RENAME TO tech_new_034;
ALTER TABLE tech_new_034 DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS tech_pkey;
ALTER TABLE tech_new_034 DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS tech_id_key;
ALTER TABLE tech_new_034 DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS tech_label_key;

CREATE TABLE tech (
    label character varying(64) NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY
);

ALTER TABLE tech ADD CONSTRAINT tech_id_key UNIQUE (id);
ALTER TABLE tech ADD CONSTRAINT tech_label_key UNIQUE (label);

INSERT INTO tech (id, label, created_at)
SELECT id, label, created_at
FROM tech_new_034
ORDER BY id;

SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('tech', 'id'), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM tech), 1), true);

ALTER TABLE tag RENAME TO tag_new_034;
ALTER TABLE tag_new_034 DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS tag_pkey;
ALTER TABLE tag_new_034 DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS tag_id_key;
ALTER TABLE tag_new_034 DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS tag_slug_key;

CREATE TABLE tag (
    name character varying(255),
    slug character varying(255),
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY
);

ALTER TABLE tag ADD CONSTRAINT tag_id_key UNIQUE (id);
ALTER TABLE tag ADD CONSTRAINT tag_slug_key UNIQUE (slug);

INSERT INTO tag (id, name, slug, created_at)
SELECT id, name, slug, created_at
FROM tag_new_034
ORDER BY id;

SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('tag', 'id'), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM tag), 1), true);

ALTER TABLE tech_version RENAME TO tech_version_new_034;
ALTER TABLE tech_version_new_034 DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS tech_version_pkey;
ALTER TABLE tech_version_new_034 DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS tech_version_id_key;
ALTER TABLE tech_version_new_034 DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS tech_version_tech_id_version_key;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_tech_version_tech_id;

CREATE TABLE tech_version (
    version character varying(32) NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    tech_id integer NOT NULL
);

ALTER TABLE tech_version ADD CONSTRAINT tech_version_id_key UNIQUE (id);
ALTER TABLE tech_version ADD CONSTRAINT tech_version_tech_id_version_key UNIQUE (tech_id, version);
CREATE INDEX idx_tech_version_tech_id ON tech_version (tech_id);

INSERT INTO tech_version (id, tech_id, version, created_at)
SELECT id, tech_id, version, created_at
FROM tech_version_new_034
ORDER BY id;

SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('tech_version', 'id'), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM tech_version), 1), true);

ALTER TABLE tech_version
    ADD CONSTRAINT tech_version_tech_id_fkey
    FOREIGN KEY (tech_id) REFERENCES tech(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;

ALTER TABLE course
    ADD CONSTRAINT fk_course_main_tech
    FOREIGN KEY (main_tech_id) REFERENCES tech(id);

ALTER TABLE course_tech
    ADD CONSTRAINT course_tech_tech_id_fkey
    FOREIGN KEY (tech_id) REFERENCES tech(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;

ALTER TABLE compose_config_tech
    ADD CONSTRAINT compose_config_tech_tech_id_fkey
    FOREIGN KEY (tech_id) REFERENCES tech(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;

ALTER TABLE course_tag
    ADD CONSTRAINT course_tag_tag_id_fkey
    FOREIGN KEY (tag_id) REFERENCES tag(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;

ALTER TABLE lesson_tag
    ADD CONSTRAINT lesson_tag_tag_id_fkey
    FOREIGN KEY (tag_id) REFERENCES tag(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;

ALTER TABLE course_version
    ADD CONSTRAINT fk_course_version_tech_version
    FOREIGN KEY (tech_version_id) REFERENCES tech_version(id);

ALTER TABLE course_version_i18n
    ADD CONSTRAINT course_version_i18n_i18n_id_fkey
    FOREIGN KEY (i18n_id) REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;

ALTER TABLE lesson_i18n
    ADD CONSTRAINT lesson_i18n_i18n_id_fkey
    FOREIGN KEY (i18n_id) REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;

ALTER TABLE task_i18n
    ADD CONSTRAINT task_i18n_i18n_id_fkey
    FOREIGN KEY (i18n_id) REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;

ALTER TABLE task_test_i18n
    ADD CONSTRAINT task_test_i18n_i18n_id_fkey
    FOREIGN KEY (i18n_id) REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;

ALTER TABLE task_test_variant_i18n
    ADD CONSTRAINT task_test_variant_i18n_i18n_id_fkey
    FOREIGN KEY (i18n_id) REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;

DROP TABLE tech_version_new_034;
DROP TABLE tag_new_034;
DROP TABLE tech_new_034;
DROP TABLE i18n_new_034;

COMMIT;
